'''2000 Krakow Grand Slam''' was the Star Wars CCG constructed event of a Grand Slam 2000 weekend, one of 31 Decipher special tournament weekends in 2000. The winner was to receive a complete set of uncut sheets. The source does not record a winner.<ref name="gs00">[http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Grand Slam 2000], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010716001210/http://bbs.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="gs00cal">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Grand Slam calendar], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010311080940/http://calder.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Grand Slam (constructed)
* '''Date:''' September 2000
* '''Site:''' Kraków, Poland

== Notes ==

* Decipher's Grand Slam 2000 results page lists this weekend but records no Star Wars CCG winner.<ref name="gs00" />
* The calendar gives the weekend as 9–10 September 2000 in "Poland"; the results page names Krakow.<ref name="gs00" />
* The date and site come from Decipher's calendar of upcoming events; no source confirms the event was held as scheduled.
